title: Figure 7: Spacecraft weight trends vs. hypersonic L/D for SV, FDL and MRS families
description: Graph of normalized weight W (0.5-1.5) versus "Hypersonic L/D" (0-3) with three colored trend lines labeled "SV FAMILY," "FDL FAMILY" and "MRS FAMILY," each data point linked to a small color vehicle illustration; a "Ballistic" capsule point sits at low L/D. The plot includes the formula W = W0 · (1 + L/D / 11.1). Caption: "Figure 7. Detailed Design Analyses Show the Weight Trends are as Much a Function of Configuration Family as Lift-to-Drag Ratio."
